item.description:
Theme Squeeze 0.1.0

  • Introduces the standalone Theme Squeeze edition with a separate app identity, local data namespace, graphite-and-citrus icon, and neutral installer.
  • Includes Media, Theme / web, Email, Ads, and Social workspaces with batch compression, quality comparison, crop tools, and editable delivery recipes.
  • Keeps media processing local, preserves originals, and adds an independent signed update feed for the Personal edition.
